answer.origin: NVIDIA Corporation blog post dated 2026-07-01, a party statement by the covered company, with embedded quotes from Sharon AI's CEO and Firmus Technologies' co-CEO and descriptions of Firmus's Batam campus taken from NVIDIA's own text.
answer.note: NVIDIA's own 2026-07-01 blog post describes a new business model in which AI clouds procure NVIDIA infrastructure to serve AI-native, enterprise and ISV customers, supported by a revenue-sharing and credit-support structure. In this structure NVIDIA would earn both standard product revenue and a share of cloud revenue on the supported capacity, which NVIDIA describes as a recurring, usage-linked earnings stream. If implemented as described, this points to NVIDIA's economics shifting partly toward usage-linked cloud revenue on capacity it helps finance, which would add demand visibility but also exposure to partners' utilization and credit. The source gives no dollar amounts, shares, credit-support size, contract terms, or timing for NVIDIA's revenue share, so the size of the effect cannot be estimated from this source. The Firmus Batam campus (expected to scale to 360 MW and up to 170,000 NVIDIA GPUs) and the Sharon AI collaboration are company-stated expectations and partnership statements, not reported orders, deliveries or revenue. They support the view that large AI-cloud builds are being organized around NVIDIA platforms, but do not establish NVIDIA's contracted volumes.
limitations: The source gives no revenue-share percentage, credit-support amount, contract duration or accounting treatment for NVIDIA's cloud-revenue share, so the financial effect on NVIDIA cannot be quantified.
The Firmus campus figures (360 MW, up to 170,000 GPUs) are expected scale with no stated completion date, funding status or NVIDIA-specific purchase commitment.
The AI clouds participating in the model are not named beyond Sharon AI and Firmus; whether other named AI natives (Baseten, Fireworks AI, Together AI) are participants is not stated.
The source does not disclose whether any partner has signed an agreement under the model; the model is described as introduced and 'already taking shape' without signed-status detail.
The source is NVIDIA's own promotional statement and provides no independent verification of the partner quotes or campus plans.
follow_up: Check NVIDIA's next 10-Q or 10-K and earnings commentary for any disclosed revenue-share, credit-support or cloud-revenue arrangement and its financial effect.
Check Firmus and Sharon AI public filings or announcements for construction timing, financing and any NVIDIA supply or credit-support agreement covering the Batam campus.
Check whether NVIDIA disclosed the size of any credit guarantees or receivables tied to AI-cloud partners in its filings, to assess the credit-support exposure.
